name: Visit Bogotá
body: HSTS marked for preload, nosniff, a content security policy, a canonical, and a clear description. But real Chrome visitors wait 436 ms at the 75th percentile for the page to respond to a tap or click.
lesson: Find long tasks in the Performance panel and split them. Keep INP under 200 ms.
summary: visitbogota.co scores 79 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: referrer-Policy is not sent.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 17 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 17 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: The start page took 2416 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 4.0 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 436 ms (needs improvement), Cumulative Layout Shift 0 (good). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Break up long JavaScript tasks behind clicks and taps, and defer…

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
